title: Generative AI Arcade
intro: Create, prompt, and win! Test your generative AI and prompt skills. First-try wins earn ⭐⭐⭐.

rounds.explain: Generative AI creates new text, images, music, or video — it generates rather than only analyzing.

rounds.prompt: Match each tool to what it generates.
rounds.explain: Different generative tools specialize in text, images, or music.

options: The instruction or question you give an AI
rounds.explain: A prompt is what you ask or tell the AI — better prompts give better answers.

options: Explain black holes to a 12-year-old using cricket examples
rounds.explain: It's specific about audience, topic, and style, so the AI gives a focused answer.

rounds.prompt: Match each prompt ingredient to its example.
rounds.explain: Strong prompts name the audience, the format, and the tone you want.
